query_plan.query: What is the total number of goals scored in all tournaments?

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate by tournament id, sum the goals scored to a total.
steps.query: Return all tournaments together with their goals scored, with their tournament id and tournament name.

extra.sql_query: SELECT SUM(goals_scored) AS total_goals FROM tournaments

s1.sql_query: SELECT tournaments.tournament, tournaments.name, tournaments.goals_scored FROM tournaments
